# Shape protocol v1 conformance vectors

`shape-vectors.json` is copied unchanged from
[TerraScale/terrascale](https://github.com/TerraScale/terrascale/blob/993927ce7ecf8f9b889d24d4d1d21ec96eaf9416/docs/terrabase/shape-vectors.json),
commit `993927ce7ecf8f9b889d24d4d1d21ec96eaf9416` (main, retrieved 2026-10-14).

The accompanying source contracts are `docs/terrabase/shape-reads.md` and
`docs/terrabase/free-reads.md` at the same commit. These fixtures contain only
synthetic keys, tokens, URLs and data. Tests use HTTP fakes; no TerraBase process
is downloaded or run by this repository.
